rv.q: The rest of director Johanna McKenzie Miller's production is a mixed bag.
Blank Theatre Company has once again proven themselves willing and capable of putting a fresh spin on beloved classics.
You won’t find a more fun evening than one spent with The Blank Theatre Company.
Full of camp and with a powerhouse cast, Sweet Charity makes for a night of fun.
This Sweet Charity has its head on its shoulders and a glowing performance at its core.
Blank Theatre Company's new production of Sweet Charity is all of these things with flair.
Teah Kiang Mirabelli shines as the star of Sweet Charity, beaming and full of sunshiney optimism as she embarks on her quest for love.
The Musical Director, Aaron Kaplan, has worked these cast members well and we heard the music as it was intended to be done.

cn.t: Critics praise Blank Theatre's gutsy, intimate production of this Fosse classic, highlighting lead Teah Kiang Mirabelli's sunny optimism and impressive choreography that overcomes the smaller venue's spatial constraints.
